ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 3 cm cubes
bundles scallions , whites and pale greens cut into 3 cm segments
garlic , grated — the garlic leads here
of the reserved marinade + 1 tbsp melted butter or extra sesame oil
Steamed rice , cho-gochujang on the side as the dip, kimchi

instructions.heading: Step 1
instructions.action: Medium-hot fire, skewers laid across with a finger's width between them. First side undisturbed 3 minutes — the cubes need to release, and the scallion wants one face charred softly.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: turn a test skewer: the chicken's underside should be browned with grill lines and release cleanly; the scallion's face should be charred at the tips and glossy in the middle. If the scallion is incinerated, the fire is a notch hot for its tolerance — slide the scallion ends toward the fire's cooler edge on the next round.

instructions.heading: Step 2
instructions.action: Turn every 2 minutes through three more faces, brushing with the sauce on the second turn — 8–10 minutes total. The corners of the cubes will take little char-kisses; the centers stay juicy.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: pull when a test cube's cut face is opaque to the center with clear juices — no pink, chicken's absolute rule — and the scallion has gone sweet-soft with char at the edges.

instructions.heading: Step 3
instructions.action: Off the skewer at the table or straight off the stick; sesame over; cho-gochujang (#SA03) as the dip.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: eating test: chicken and scallion from the same bite, garlic-soy glaze behind them, then the dip's sweet-heat on the finish. The stick is the portion — two skewers and rice is the honest serving.

pull when a test cube's cut face is opaque to the center with clear juices — no pink, chicken's absolute rule — and the scallion has gone sweet-soft with char at the edges.
eating test: chicken and scallion from the same bite, garlic-soy glaze behind them, then the dip's sweet-heat on the finish. The stick is the portion — two skewers and rice is the honest serving.
storageNotes: Skewers marinate 24 hours maximum, threads and all. Cooked, 3 days — pull the meat off for a rice bowl or a wrap; the stick has done its work.
Variations: thread mushrooms between the cubes for the half-vegetarian table; the gochujang marinade fork (#M17's paste on cubes); beef sirloin cubes take the same build and grill a minute faster.
